authorityBoundary.purpose: Bind the already-frozen H cognition outputs to existing Thread, genome, lineage and autobiographical-memory publication contracts without per-Thread semantic discretion.

threadSeedProjection.uniformityRule: All five seed projections are identical except threadId, provenance timestamps and the derived seed-event ID. No World, genome, origin-mode or generated-life content enters the compatibility seed.

memoryPublicationProjection.subjectOriginRule: earliest cited Pass-A episode in admitted life chronology
memoryPublicationProjection.eventRefsRule: all Pass-B cited episode refs mapped to deterministic Genesis life-event IDs and sorted by admitted life chronology
memoryPublicationProjection.subjectPeriodRule: earliest-to-latest occurredAt over cited Pass-A episodes
memoryPublicationProjection.recordedAtRule: single cohort publication timestamp captured after generation and before first birth publication

reinterpretationBinding.targetEpisodeRule: the immutable memory subject-origin Pass-A episode
reinterpretationBinding.sharedPersonRule: exact intersection of target-origin and trigger participant refs excluding the subject Thread
reinterpretationBinding.candidateScope: every later admitted Pass-A episode for every initially durable memory; the frozen scheduler computes age/relation eligibility and then applies the per-Thread run cap
reinterpretationBinding.sameMemoryMultipleRuns: each scheduled call sees the latest currently durable meaning for that memory so append-only memory revisions remain linear; the frozen eligibility/run decision itself is not recomputed from prior model outcomes
reinterpretationBinding.revisedPersistence: append a corrected memory revision with unchanged rememberedContent/eventRefs and the new durable meaning
reinterpretationBinding.unchangedOrNonePersistence: preserve the run result in H evidence without inventing a memory revision whose durable state did not change

syntheticLineagePublication.sourceGenomeOrder: frozen child genome sourceEligibility source order
